Class BoutService

java.lang.Object
org.app.services.BoutService
public class BoutService extends Object
The BoutService class provides service methods to manage Bout entities.

This class is responsible for handling operations like retrieving all bouts, retrieving bouts by tourney or attacker, and inserting new bouts into the database using JPA's EntityManager.

Key Features:

  • Supports complex query operations involving tournament and character-based filtering.
  • Performs transactional writes for bout creation to ensure data consistency.
  • Logs actions and errors using Logger from Log4j2.

    • getAllBouts

      public List<Bout> getAllBouts()
      Retrieves all bouts from the database.

      This method uses JPQL to fetch all Bout entities from the database.

      Returns:
      A list of all bouts, or null if an error occurs.

    • getBoutsByTourney

      public List<Bout> getBoutsByTourney(String tourney)
      Retrieves bouts by the name of the tourney.

      This method fetches bouts that took place in a specific tournament.

      Parameters:
      tourney - The name of the tourney for which bouts should be retrieved.
      Returns:
      A list of bouts for the given tourney, or null if an error occurs.

    • getBoutsByTourneyAndAttacker

      public List<Bout> getBoutsByTourneyAndAttacker(String tourney, String attackingCharacterKey)
      Retrieves bouts for a specific tourney and attacker character.
      Parameters:
      tourney - The name of the tourney.
      attackingCharacterKey - The key of the character who was the attacker in the bout.

    • getBoutByBoutPreciseKey

      public Bout getBoutByBoutPreciseKey(String boutKey)
      Retrieves a specific bout by its unique bout key.

      This method fetches the bout with the exact given bout key.

      Parameters:
      boutKey - The unique identifier of the bout.
      Returns:
      The bout with the given key, or null if an error occurs or no such bout exists.

    • getBoutsByBoutPartialKey

      public List<Bout> getBoutsByBoutPartialKey(String boutKey)
      Retrieves bouts using a partial bout key (e.g., for fuzzy searches).

      This method uses the SQL LIKE operator to match bouts whose keys partially match the given key.

      Parameters:
      boutKey - The partial key used to match bouts.
      Returns:
      A list of bouts matching the partial key, or null if an error occurs.

    • insertBout

      public void insertBout(Bout newBout)
      Inserts a new bout into the database.

      This method opens a transaction, persists the new Bout entity, and commits the transaction. If an error occurs, the transaction is rolled back.

      Parameters:
      newBout - The Bout entity to be inserted into the database.

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the EntityManagerFactory when the service is no longer needed.

      This method ensures that the EntityManagerFactory is closed to release any resources held by the persistence unit.
